data.narrative:
Nordic Air Defence, a seed-stage defense and security company founded by Karl Rosander, is evaluated against a peer universe of 10 private and 2 public comparables in the Defense & Security sector. The private comp set includes UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, and Shield AI; public references are DRSHF and IDEAFORGE.NS.

The peer-median method was applied using three same-sector, same- or adjacent-stage comparables. UFORCE (Seed) was valued at $1.0B, Singularity (Series A) at $400M, and NODA AI (Series A) at $125M, yielding a median valuation of $400M with a range spanning $125M to $1.0B. This peer-median method represents the sole quantitative triangulation method applicable given available data constraints.

The triangulation analysis supports a valuation range of $340M to $460M, with a median implied value of $400M. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the three-peer sample—particularly the wide dispersion from $125M to $1.0B—and limited stage alignment, as two peers are at Series A rather than seed stage. The single-method triangulation constrains confidence in range precision. Additional revenue multiples, DCF modeling, or precedent transaction data would strengthen conviction in this valuation band.
